title.zh: 以自然材质构建安静睡眠空间
title.en: Quiet sleeping spaces built from natural materials

text.zh: 让旅人在城市中恢复能量。没有多余的装饰，只有恰到好处的光、风与安静。
text.en: Where travellers recover energy within the city. Nothing superfluous — just light, air and silence, in the right measure.

poem.zh: 窗外的光被纱帘滤成柔软的黄昏，床是一整天的终点。
poem.en: Light filtered through sheer linen becomes a soft dusk — the bed is where the day ends.

description.zh: 以暖白与木色为底，大床居于房间中心，像岛。织物、灯光与隔音一起，把城市的喧嚣留在门外。
description.en: Warm white and pale wood; the king bed sits at the centre like an island. Fabric, light and sound-proofing keep the city outside the door.

facilities.zh: 独立淋浴 · 天然洗护
智能客控 · AI 语音管家

poem.zh: 一张窗，两个方向：一面向城市灯火，一面向内心平静。
poem.en: One window, two directions — city lights on one side, inner calm on the other.

description.zh: 为结伴出行而设。两张床中间以木质格栅轻隔，保留各自安静，又不失彼此陪伴。
description.en: Made for travelling together. A wooden lattice softly divides the twin beds — privacy for each, company for both.

facilities.zh: 格栅木隔断 · 动静分区
智能客控 · AI 语音管家

poem.zh: 一间属于自己的小院，让清晨的鸟鸣代替闹钟。
poem.en: A small courtyard of your own — where birdsong, not alarm, wakes you.

description.zh: 带私人庭院或阳台的套房。清晨在院子里喝第一杯茶，夜晚看星——微度假的完整形态。
description.en: A suite with a private courtyard or terrace. First tea in the garden, stars at night — the complete micro-vacation.

facilities.zh: 智能客控 · AI 语音管家

poem.zh: 全城尽收眼底，而喧嚣在九层之下。
poem.en: The whole city below you — its noise nine floors away.

description.zh: 酒店最高处的套房，整面落地窗收藏义乌的天际线。傍晚的霞光、夜间的灯火，都是你的房间。
description.en: The highest suite in the hotel, walled in glass, collecting Yiwu's skyline — dusk light and evening lamps become part of the room.

facilities.zh: 全景落地窗 · 天际线景致
专属管家 · AI 礼宾
